name: AK18E - Pocket Formaldehyde & TVOC Detector (HCHO, TVOC), Electrochemical Formaldehyde Sensor
highlights: The AK18D With Electrochemical Formaldehyde — Same 39 g body, same two readings, same 100-per-carton pack. The formaldehyde channel moves from a semiconductor element to an electrochemical cell — selective where the semiconductor is not.

Why It Costs More Than AK18D — A semiconductor element responds to formaldehyde and to a dozen other things. An electrochemical cell responds to formaldehyde. When the number is going to be quoted to a landlord or a client, that distinction is the whole product.
TVOC Alongside — The broader VOC channel remains, so the pair still tells a complete story about a room's materials.
500 mAh, USB-C — About an hour to charge, 39 g.
100 Per Carton — Same enclosure and packing as AK18D — the upgrade tier without a second carton spec.
